decision: Model policy for zentala.eu: research and inventories run on cheaper models (sonnet); design documents, editorial standards, chapter text and AI-facing instructions run on the best model (fable).
rationale: Paweł: "do researchu używaj tańszych agentów; do projektowania Design MD, tekstów, instrukcji dla AI używaj najlepszego modelu. Nie żałuj sobie na to."
scope: zentala.eu E006 and later content work

decision: Standards before volume: no further chapter is written or rewritten until DESIGN.md, src/content/AGENTS.md (editorial standard) and the IA document exist and Paweł has approved them.
rationale: The 20 chapters written from dictation without a standard came out uneven and prose-only; the fix is the standard, not another pass.
